name: apify-scrapers-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for live B2B lead extraction, Glassdoor jobs, SEC EDGAR filings, and US federal contract intelligence via Apify.

tools.name: google_maps_search
tools.description: Search local B2B leads, contractors, phone numbers, ratings, and addresses on Google Maps.

tools.name: glassdoor_jobs_search
tools.description: Search Glassdoor job postings with canonical URLs and normalized posting dates.

tools.name: sec_edgar_filings
tools.description: Search historical and recent SEC 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings by stock ticker or company name.

tools.name: usaspending_contracts
tools.description: Search federal awards, defense procurement contracts, and prime recipient obligations.
